topic: 60g Daily Protein Hack for Indian Beginners
caption:
Kya aapka daily protein target complete ho raha hai?
Most beginners supplements par kharcha karte hain jabki daily ghar ke khane mein simple tweaks karke easy 60g hit kar sakte ho.
Small additions like dahi, paneer, eggs aur soya chunks aapka pura game badal denge.
Aapka daily favourite protein source kaunsa hai—Paneer, Eggs ya Soya? Comment karke batao!
